title: Dependency Graph
description: Schema for .topology/graphs/dependency-graph.json per APS-V1-0001 §3.4.2: the module dependency graph code-topology writes and APS-V1-0002 ST01 dependency rules read. An edge means `from` depends on (imports) `to`. Every edge endpoint MUST be the `id` of a node in `nodes` (JSON Schema cannot express that; consumers MUST reject a dangling endpoint).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this artifact shape. Consumers accept any 2.x.

metadata.description: Informational counts; not part of the contract consumers evaluate.

id.description: Module identity, unique within the graph (e.g. `domain::model`).

path.description: Source file of the module relative to the analysis root, `/` separators (e.g. `src/domain/model.rs`). ST01 path globs match this; two modules in one file share it.

weight.description: Number of imports behind the edge.

imports.description: The import statements behind the edge, as the language adapter reports them.
